title: The 1% Fee Costing You Six Figures
hook_text: YOUR INVESTMENT APP IS STEALING SIX FIGURES

beats.say: Your investment app is quietly stealing six figures from your retirement account, and they legally charge you for doing it.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a dark, rain-slick smartphone screen reflecting cold sodium light on an empty asphalt street at night.

beats.say: You put $100,000 into a fund for 30 years and assume a standard 7% return over three decades.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive concrete bridge pier cutting upward against a foggy blue hour sky.

beats.say: Most people think a 1% annual management fee is just pocket change for professional portfolio handling.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a lone commuter silhouette walking across an empty concrete parking deck in the rain.

beats.say: That tiny 1% bite doesn't just skim your profits. It devours your compounding growth entirely.
beats.visual: High angle shot of dark industrial water rushing under a heavy iron underpass at midnight.

beats.say: When the math runs for 30 years, that 1% fee leaves you with $574,349 total.
beats.visual: Single practical overhead light casting a harsh shadow over a worn wooden table in a vacant room.

beats.say: Drop that fee down to 0.05%, and that exact same portfolio surges to $750,626.
beats.visual: Close-up of a heavy steel door hinge glistening with moisture under a cold fluorescent tube.

beats.say: Where does that massive difference of $176,277 actually vanish to over those decades?
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary freight train disappearing into a dark mountain tunnel at dusk.

beats.say: It doesn't buy better management. It feeds the firm while your money works alone.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a towering brick facade fading into deep evening shadows with no lights on.

beats.say: A 1% fee steals over $176,000 in lost compounding gains over a 30-year span.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of dark water droplets sliding down a cold concrete wall under sodium light.

beats.say: Check your expense ratios today before your hidden fees fund someone else's retirement.
beats.visual: High angle shot of an empty highway at night with single red taillights fading into the distance.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a lone person walking away down a dark urban alley under a single practical light.

caption: That 1% fee isn't a tip. It's a six-figure tax on your future. #investing #personalfinance #wealth #money #retirement
